description: The second page, the citations: every source behind a verdict with its standing in a ledger table, every quote deep-linked to the passage it came from in a quote callout, the claim map, open questions folded into a collapsed warning callout, and object-keyed footnotes. Renders from its own data or from the same data as verdict.knap: the heading falls back from the apparatus page name to `title`, and the back-link to the verdict appears only when it names a different page. Section headings, callout kinds and callout titles belong to the template; write values only. Plain strings, no markdown: the template does all formatting.

title.role: page heading and frontmatter `title`; the apparatus page name when `apparatus_page` is absent

subtitle.role: deck line, rendered italic; falls back to a stock line via ??

apparatus_page.role: name of this apparatus page; wins over `title` for the heading via ??

verdict_page.role: name of the verdict page this apparatus backs; a [[wikilink]] in frontmatter `verdict` and the 'receipts behind' line. Omit (or equal to the heading) to drop the back-link

sources.role: citation list: one ledger row and one h3 section each, names rendered as [[wikilinks]]

name.role: target name for [[wikilink]]; name only pages that exist, an invented name is a dangling wikilink

url.role: deep link target (http/https, no #fragment); the 'Read the source' link and the deep-link target for every quote

rel.role: relationship tag, rendered as inline code, e.g. documentation|self-published|benchmark

gaf.role: how much this source moved the verdict: high|medium|low

accessed.role: access date, YYYY-MM-DD; falls back to undated via ??

quotes.role: verbatim pulls, one 'Pulled quote' callout each

text.role: verbatim quote copied from the page at `url`, one line. Deep-linked with #:~:text=, so it must match the source text exactly; no unbalanced parentheses

used_for.role: what the quote backs, one line

receipts.role: the claim map: one pipe-table row per claim; header row is fixed in the template

source.role: name of a page in `sources`, rendered as a [[wikilink]]; omit for 'nothing yet'

confidence.role: high|medium|low; falls back to unrated via ??

note.role: key into `footnotes`; renders a [^key] footnote ref after the claim. Must match a `footnotes` key exactly

caveats.role: open questions, bulleted inside the collapsed 'Open questions' warning callout

footnotes.role: footnotes: key -> note text, rendered as [^key]: definitions. Keys are short kebab-case labels. Every key should be referenced by some receipt `note`, and every `note` must be a key here; format_check flags strays
